final: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT s.questregistry, s.zoneref, s.pressratio, si.riskeval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM matched_scans), grouped_data AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_compression, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression, scan_count, CAST(scan_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share FROM grouped_data ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
